verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a RESTful API with JWT authentication, regional endpoints, static Bash/Python/Java code samples and an MCP/CLI offering, but nothing shows an official client SDK package. Raw REST calls, copy-paste samples, a CLI and third-party gateways (fal.ai, Vercel AI Gateway) are adjacent building blocks or other products, not official SDKs. The axis applies to an API platform like Kling, so the lack of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
